title: Flashflow
tagline: Unlock tomorrow’s rent, subs, or invoices today; invest in real-world cash flow!
description:
FlashFlow Protocol is a marketplace where anyone can instantly turn future income like rent, SaaS subscriptions, royalties, or invoices into upfront cash, while investors gain access to diverse, real-world cash flow portfolios.

Landlords, entrepreneurs, and creators simply upload proof of their expected payments. Our backend uses AI-powered risk checks to group and “basketize” these income streams into secure, easy-to-invest tokens. Investors buy shares in these baskets, earning yield as the pooled payments flow in over time. Everything is automated, transparent, and settled in fUSD on Kadena’s scalable blockchain making it low-cost, fast, and secure.

No more waiting months for payment, and no more relying on a single client or tenant. With FlashFlow, anyone from property owners and SaaS founders to fans of creators can unlock new capital or invest in the real economy with just a few clicks. It’s finance, reimagined for everyone.
how_its_made: FlashFlow uses Kadena’s EVM chain for basketized tokenization and fUSD payouts. Gemini AI runs risk scoring off-chain in our Node backend, while a React frontend handles uploads and investments. We added modular Self.xyz hooks and a payment mocker for demo flows.
